dataset.name: T7 Blinded Hardware Review Set (Preloaded Demo)

items.requirement_prompt: Design an active-high synchronous alarm latch module. The latch must assert an alarm signal whenever the fault input is asserted on a clock edge and remain asserted until an active-high reset signal is applied. If both fault and reset occur simultaneously on the same clock cycle, reset must take strict priority and clear the alarm.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire clk,
input wire rst_n, // active-low asynchronous system reset
input wire sync_rst, // synchronous clear with priority
input wire fault,
output reg alarm
model_question: Should the alarm output register update on the rising edge or falling edge of the clock signal, and does sync_rst take precedence over an active fault if both assert in the same cycle?
items.oracle_answer: The alarm register must update exclusively on the positive (rising) clock edge. sync_rst has strict priority over fault.
items.generated_response:
`default_nettype none
module alarm_latch (
    input  wire clk,
    input  wire rst_n,
    input  wire sync_rst,
    input  wire fault,
    output reg  alarm
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        alarm <= 1'b0;
    end else if (sync_rst) begin
        alarm <= 1'b0;
    end else if (fault) begin
        alarm <= 1'b1;
    end
end

endmodule

items.requirement_prompt: Implement a 2-entry circular FIFO with single-cycle push and pop operations, 8-bit data width, and instantaneous full and empty status flags. Simultaneous read and write on a non-empty, non-full FIFO must succeed in the same clock cycle without data corruption.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire clk,
input wire rst_n,
input wire push,
input wire pop,
input wire [7:0] data_in,
output reg [7:0] data_out,
output wire full,
output wire empty
model_question: When the FIFO is empty and push is asserted simultaneously with pop, should data pass directly through (fall-through) or should pop be treated as invalid and ignored?
items.oracle_answer: When empty, simultaneous push and pop is not a pass-through mode; push writes into slot 0 and pop is ignored because the FIFO was empty at the cycle start.

items.requirement_prompt: Construct a 4-client round-robin arbiter with fair token rotation. The arbiter receives 4 request signals (req[3:0]) and grants exactly one client per cycle (grant[3:0]). If no requests are active, grant must be 4'b0000.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire clk,
input wire rst_n,
input wire [3:0] req,
output reg [3:0] grant

items.requirement_prompt: Develop an 8-bit priority encoder with valid flag output. Input in[7:0] has in[7] as highest priority and in[0] as lowest. Output code[2:0] corresponds to the highest asserted input bit.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire [7:0] in,
output reg [2:0] code,
output reg valid

items.requirement_prompt: Design a two-flop synchronizer module with pulse edge detection for crossing clock domains from a slow asynchronous domain to a fast 100MHz system clock domain.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire clk,
input wire rst_n,
input wire async_pulse,
output wire sync_pulse_out
model_question: Is the async_pulse signal guaranteed to be at least two system clock cycles wide, or must an input latch capture sub-cycle glitches?
items.oracle_answer: The async_pulse is at least two destination clock periods wide. Standard double-register synchronizer without glitch-capture latch is expected.

items.requirement_prompt: Implement an active-high synchronous alarm latch module. The latch must assert an alarm signal whenever the fault input is asserted on a clock edge and remain asserted until an active-high reset signal is applied. If both fault and reset occur simultaneously on the same clock cycle, reset must take strict priority and clear the alarm.
items.module_ports:
MODULE PORTS:
input wire clk,
input wire rst_n,
input wire sync_rst,
input wire fault,
output reg alarm
model_question: Should alarm assert immediately combinations-wise or strictly register on clock edge?
items.oracle_answer: Strictly registered on the positive clock edge.
items.generated_response:
module alarm_latch_v2 (
    input  wire clk,
    input  wire rst_n,
    input  wire sync_rst,
    input  wire fault,
    output reg  alarm
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        alarm <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (fault) alarm <= 1'b1;
        if (sync_rst) alarm <= 1'b0; // sync_rst evaluated second for priority
    end
end

endmodule
